decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed side dormer window and proposed side extension are considered unsatisfactory in the form shown on the drawings submitted to date. Detailed drawings of the proposed side dormer and side extension to a scale of not less than 1:50 shall be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development commences and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval given.
description: Erection of single storey side extension and roof extension to dwellinghouse
